findings.claim: Starting a new scenario or resetting does not clear or deny an already pending destructive approval, allowing a stale human decision from a prior surface/scenario to mutate the graph later.
findings.evidence: The acceptance evidence requires human approval boundaries and states that scenario start/reset clear prior agent state; however `run()` only calls `clearAgentSurfaces()` and resets session fields, and `reset()` clears surfaces/graph/audit but never imports or resolves `approvalStore`, while `approval-store.ts` keeps `pending` until `resolve()` is called.
findings.suggested_fix: On `run()` and `reset()`, fail closed any pending approval before clearing state, e.g. call `approvalStore.getState().resolve(false)` or add an explicit `clearPending()` that denies and resolves the active promise.

findings.claim: The external A2A URL path can embed and expose credentials despite the documented no-token browser boundary.
findings.evidence: `configuredExternalEndpoint` directly accepts `import.meta.env.VITE_EXTERNAL_A2A_URL` and passes it to `createExternalA2AExecutor`, while `AgentControls` renders `session.configuration.endpoint` in both text and `title`; the acceptance text says the browser example does not accept or embed an agent token and authenticated production routing belongs in a server-side gateway.
findings.suggested_fix: Parse `VITE_EXTERNAL_A2A_URL` and reject any URL with `username` or `password` before storing/rendering it; also add a regression test for `https://token@example.com/a2a`.
